opportunities.title: Build the evaluation-first LLM router
opportunities.problem: The model router uses static per-step model choices, so the system cannot measure output quality or route easier tasks to cheaper models with confidence.
blocked_by: Needs representative evaluation datasets and judge-model credentials before dynamic routing can be enabled.
evidence: Active proposal defines evaluator, routing decisions, calibration, and CLI/API interfaces.
Current docs emphasize content quality and review workflows but there is no gen-eval report available.
Potential cost and quality payoff is high, but implementation breadth spans services, config, models, CLI, and persistence.

evidence: Active proposal has a 34-task plan.
